title: An agent does not commit with a message file, or overwrite a file, that another agent wrote in the shared scratchpad
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict (session_013NEJL3ZjZdzrS8tBezxY85), 12:34 CST Nov 8: a test-author ran `git commit -F probe/commit_msg.txt` from the session's shared scratchpad; another agent had written that file, so the commit carried the other agent's message. It amended before the push, so nothing wrong landed. Its Writes also overwrote probe/probe.py and probe/one_mutant.py, made by another agent. Fix: refuse `git commit -F <file>` and a Write over a file this agent did not write, or give each agent its own scratchpad folder. Sibling of scratchpad-file-ownership (#2023, which covers running such a script).
note: #2271 now has lane session_013NEJL2C3ooJFEuJnsQf4yT (coordinator 03:49 CST Nov 9). Note (coordinator, 04:33 CST Nov 9): a commit run inside `bash -c '...'` is probably not judged (unmeasured), and the decision's gap list leaves it out. Sighting (lane notes-fix-large-1, #2432 builder on Sonnet, reported 08:14 CST Nov 9): the builder overwrote, then deleted, a cases.txt that another agent wrote in the session's shared scratchpad.
